lesotho.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Lesotho

colors.note: Top band symbolising rain, which gives Lesotho its lifeblood water.
Bottom band evoking prosperity and the land.
Mokorotlo Basotho hat, symbolising the indigenous culture of the nation.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of blue (top), white (middle) and green (bottom)
- A black mokorotlo, the traditional Basotho straw hat, is centred on the white band
- Adopted on 4 October 2006 for the 40th anniversary of independence, replacing an earlier military-themed design
trivia:
- The 1987-2006 flag bore a shield with an assegai and knobkerrie, reflecting military rule
- Lesotho is entirely surrounded by South Africa, one of only three fully enclaved states
- The mokorotlo is said to be modelled on Mount Qiloane in the Thaba Bosiu region
